=== fields and methods
class A {
  int field
  String name
  void method()
  int compute(int x)
  {static} int counter
  {abstract} void doIt()
  {classifier} int c
  {field} weird()
  {method} notMethod
  {static} {abstract} both()
}
=== visibilities
class A {
  -private
  #protected
  ~package
  +public
  -privateMethod()
  #protectedMethod()
  ~packageMethod()
  +publicMethod()
  *mandatory
  --double
  ++
}
=== separators
class A {
  a
  --
  b
  ..
  c
  ==
  d
  __
  e
  -- title --
  f
  .. other ..
}
=== empty lines
class A {

  a

  b()

  c()

}
=== members with urls
class A {
  field [[http://x]]
  method() [[http://y{tip}]]
  +vis [[[http://z]]]
}
=== add method lines
A : field
A : method()
A : -private
B : {static} s
"Quoted" : q
a.b.C : x
=== add method on package
package P {
}
P : something
=== object fields
object O {
  name = "x"
  age = 30
  -vis = 1
  method() = 2
}
=== guillemets in members
class A {
  <<create>> make()
  field <<tag>>
}
=== comments in body
class A {
  ' comment
  field
  'other
}
=== body with creole
class A {
  **bold**
  <color:red>red</color>
  |= table |
  |  x |
}
=== members with modifiers case
class A {
  {STATIC} upper
  {Abstract} mixed()
  {FIELD} f()
  {METHOD} m
}
=== long body
class A {
  a1
  a2()
  a3
  a4()
  a5
  a6()
}
=== tabs in body
class A {
	tabbed
		double tab()
}
=== method between fields with blank
class A {
  m1()

  m2()
  f
}
